name: Xorderable Array
description: You are given an array $$$A$$$ of $$$N$$$ integers: $$$[A_1, A_2, \dots, A_N]$$$. The array $$$A$$$ is $$$(p, q)$$$-xorderable if it is possible to rearrange $$$A$$$ such that for each pair $$$(i, j)$$$ that satisfies $$$1 \leq i \lt j \leq N$$$, the following conditions must be satisfied after the rearrangement: $$$A_i \oplus p \leq A_j \oplus q$$$ and $$$A_i \oplus q \leq A_j \oplus p$$$. The operator $$$\oplus$$$ represents the bitwise xor . You are given another array $$$X$$$ of length $$$M$$$: $$$[X_1, X_2, \dots, X_M]$$$. Calculate the number of pairs $$$(u, v)$$$ where array $$$A$$$ is $$$(X_u, X_v)$$$-xorderable for $$$1 \leq u \lt v \leq M$$$.
input_specification: The first line consists of two integers $$$N$$$ $$$M$$$ ($$$2 \leq N, M \leq 200\,000)$$$. The second line consists of $$$N$$$ integers $$$A_i$$$ ($$$0 \leq A_i \lt 2^{30})$$$. The third line consists of $$$M$$$ integers $$$X_u$$$ ($$$0 \leq X_u \lt 2^{30})$$$.
output_specification: Output a single integer representing the number of pairs $$$(u, v)$$$ where array $$$A$$$ is $$$(X_u, X_v)$$$-xorderable for $$$1 \leq u \lt v \leq M$$$.
approach_summary: Maintain prefix sums and dynamic point updates via Fenwick tree using lowbit operations (i & -i) in O(log N) time and O(N) space.

topic_editorial.title: Editorial: 2045J — Xorderable Array [70. BIT / Fenwick Tree]
topic_editorial.summary: Point updates and range prefix queries with Fenwick Tree.
topic_editorial.key_invariant: Every integer $i$ has a unique binary decomposition. Index $i$ in a Binary Indexed Tree stores the cumulative sum of the interval $(i - \text{lowbit}(i), i]$, allowing logarithmic traversal via $i \mathrel{+}= (i \mathbin{\&} -i)$ and $i \mathrel{-}= (i \mathbin{\&} -i)$.
